description: This source file contains a fuzzing test for the net::HostCache class, verifying that parsing a JSON list into a HostCache and then serializing it back reproduces the original JSON list. It includes environment setup, input handling, JSON parsing, HostCache restoration, and serialization, with logging and statistical tracking.
